card werk-contract-facts  [decided]
Four facts gate decided, each with a written escape hatch
why: A silent default hides a missing fact. An escape hatch turns the gap into a record.

Four facts must hold before a card is decided:
- `who` is set.
- A basis exists: a depends_on target or a refines parent that is decided and not stale, or `--no-basis` states that none applies. While the basis is open or stale, the card waits (#map-wait). A decided parent is a basis for its child, so a child never needs a depends_on link to its parent.
- When `who` is you, an alternative_to option node exists, or `--unchallenged` states that none was weighed. A `me` or `prototype` card needs neither.
- A kill criterion is on record (#kill-ask). `werk kill` records one. A criterion of the form no-metric or revisit states that no metric applies (#kill-shape).

`edit` accepts `--who`, `--no-basis`, and `--unchallenged`, and `werk kill` adds a criterion. A card fixes a missing fact without being created again.

  -> refines         werk-contract  A card cannot become decided until a program check passes
  -> depends_on      pr-gate  A written rule is enforced by a check when a record moves to a new state
       why: The four facts follow the #pr-gate rule that a check fires at a state change and every rule has a written escape hatch.
  <- depends_on      werk-contract-guess  Unchallenged is a recorded fact, not a value derived from the data
  <- refines         werk-contract-facts:opt0  Every decided card needs an option or --unchallenged
  <- alternative_to  werk-contract-facts:opt0  Every decided card needs an option or --unchallenged
  <- depends_on      vi-prop-nolineage  A depends_on link never points to an ancestor or a descendant
  <- depends_on      map-frozen  A decided card is frozen. A change to it is an amend: a reopen and a decide in one step
  <- depends_on      map-wait  A card on a stale basis waits. It is not stale

card werk-cli-link  [open]  PROPOSED — not in the map until it is accepted
werk link and werk unlink add or remove one typed link between two cards
why: Linking is the only way to write an edge, so every rule about which links are allowed is checked here, at the moment the link is made.

```
werk link <from> <to> --type refines|depends_on|supported_by|alternative_to [--why "..."]
werk unlink <from> <to> --type <t>
```

- A depends_on link needs `--why`: what <from> takes from <to> (#vi-prop-linkwhy). Without it, the command fails.
- Linking an existing depends_on pair again replaces its reason.
- A depends_on link to an ancestor or a descendant of <from> fails, and the message says why (#vi-prop-nolineage).
- A link on a ghost card is held until the card is accepted (#werk-propose-new).
- `werk unlink` removes one link from the map. The log keeps it.

  -> refines         werk-cli  The CLI is the agent's interface to the map, and each verb belongs to the card that defines its operation
  -> depends_on      vi-prop-nolineage  A depends_on link never points to an ancestor or a descendant
       why: The command refuses an ancestor or descendant target because #vi-prop-nolineage forbids such a link.
  -> depends_on      vi-prop-linkwhy  A depends_on link carries one sentence that says why
       why: The required --why, and its replacement on a second link, carry the reason that #vi-prop-linkwhy requires.
  -> depends_on      werk-propose-new  A new card is a proposal too, not a direct append
       why: A link on a ghost is held because #werk-propose-new holds every edge of a ghost until acceptance.

The command moves a card to decided only if the four facts hold (#werk-contract-facts). It checks the log, not the card text.

- A missing fact makes the command fail. The message names the command that fixes it, with the card id filled in (#werk-contract-fix).
- `who`, the basis flag and the unchallenged flag are set with `werk edit` (#werk-cli-edit).
- A kill criterion is recorded with `werk kill` (#kill). One call adds one criterion.
- On a ghost, the check runs against the held edges, so the card commits as one unit (#werk-propose-new).
- `werk rederive <id> --status decided` runs the same check (#rederive-reason).
- The command never changes the text of a card (#map-frozen).' && node src/cli.ts add werk-cli-edit --title "werk edit sets who, --no-basis and --unchallenged on a card without recreating it" --why "A card that fails the decide check needs one missing fact recorded. Edit is the one command that records it, so the fix never costs a new card." --parent werk-cli --status open --who me --body '```
werk edit <id> [--who you|me|prototype] [--no-basis] [--unchallenged]
```

- `--who` sets who decides the card.
- `--no-basis` records that the card needs no depends_on target and no decided parent (#werk-contract-facts).
- `--unchallenged` records that no option was weighed against a `you` card (#werk-contract-guess).
- Each flag is a record on the card. None is a default.
- The flags apply to an open card. The text of a decided card is frozen: a change to it is a proposal, not an edit (#map-frozen, #al-diff-cli).
- The text of a ghost is frozen too. Discard it and propose it again (#werk-propose-new).'
